+    route-target export 2:2

+    route-target import 3:3

+        result = self.execute_module(changed=True)
+        self.assertEqual(result['commands'], ['vrf context ntc',
+                                              'address-family ipv4 unicast',
+                                              'no route-target export 2:2',
+                                              'route-target import 3:3',

+
+    def test_route_targets_default_both_absent_removes_existing_directions(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = '''vrf context ntc
+  address-family ipv4 unicast
+    route-target import 1:1
+    route-target export 1:1
+'''
+        set_module_args(dict(vrf='ntc', afi='ipv4', route_targets=[{'rt': '1:1', 'state': 'absent'}]))
+        result = self.execute_module(changed=True)
+        self.assertEqual(result['commands'], ['vrf context ntc',
+                                              'address-family ipv4 unicast',
+                                              'no route-target import 1:1',
+                                              'no route-target export 1:1'])
+
+    def test_route_targets_matching_config_is_idempotent(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = '''vrf context ntc
+  address-family ipv4 unicast
+    route-target import 1:1
+    route-target export 1:1
+'''
+        set_module_args(dict(vrf='ntc', afi='ipv4', route_targets=[
+            {'rt': '1:1'}, {'rt': '2:2', 'state': 'absent'}]))
+        result = self.execute_module(changed=False)
+        self.assertEqual(result['commands'], [])
+
+    def test_absent_address_family_ignores_route_targets(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = '''vrf context ntc
+  address-family ipv4 unicast

+'''
+        set_module_args(dict(vrf='ntc', afi='ipv4', state='absent',

+        result = self.execute_module(changed=True)
+        self.assertEqual(result['commands'], ['vrf context ntc',
